About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is looking for a Brand Design Recruiter to help build the team behind how our brand shows up in the world. You'll partner with Brand and Creative Studio leaders to define what great looks like for each search, find designers with exceptional visual craft, and guide them through a thoughtful process from first conversation to offer.

You'll need to know creative talent, recognize strong work in a portfolio, and build relationships with people before they're actively looking. You'll bring market insight to hiring conversations, keep searches moving at pace, and give candidates a clear, personal experience throughout.

  • 5+ years of recruiting experience, with a strong record of hiring brand or visual design talent.

  • A grasp of creative disciplines from identity and art direction to campaigns, web and motion, and the ability to judge a portfolio beyond the job title.

  • A record of finding and closing designers who were not actively applying, through portfolio research, communities, referrals and tailored outreach.

  • Experience building pipelines for both full-time designers and freelance creative talent, often on different timelines.

  • The ability to keep several searches and stakeholders moving with clear briefs, useful candidate evidence and accurate pipeline data.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square's mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square's presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square's visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square's full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.

What We Value:

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

  • Seek Excellence.
  • Be Selective To Be Effective.
  • Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.
  • Disagree Transparently.
  • Encourage Independent Decision-Making.
  • Build Dream Teams.

We're hiring Senior and Staff SDETs to embed across our product teams and raise the bar for quality engineering at Galaxy. You'll work on systems that move real value — crypto and fiat  across institutional-grade platforms. The problems are complex, the stakes are high, and the teams are small enough that your work will have outsized impact.

This isn't a "write tests and throw them over the wall" role. You'll shape how your team thinks about quality — designing automation strategies, influencing architecture for testability, and driving reliability across the stack. Transparency is part of the product. Our live Proof of Reserves & Liabilities dashboard gives users visibility into reported platform assets and user liabilities.

Our team is fully remote. We’re looking for people who know their craft, are curious about the business, and want a hand in improving how the exchange works.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to maintain and develop WOO X’s data platform. You’ll build the pipelines and data models that make exchange data reliable and useful for analytics, reporting, and day-to-day business decisions.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a focus on platform engineering. You’ll work with engineering and business colleagues to understand how data is produced and used, address quality issues, and make the platform easier to maintain as requirements evolve.

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines using Python, SQL, Kafka, and Spark.
  • Develop and operate Airflow workflows, including scheduling, dependency management, retries, and recovery.
  • Design and maintain data models and warehouse datasets for analytics and reporting.
  • Improve data quality and freshness through validation, monitoring, and investigation of upstream and downstream issues.
  • Optimise pipeline and query performance, and manage processing and storage costs.
  • Work with data users to define datasets and metrics, and document data flows, transformations, and dependencies.

What you’ll bring

  • Data engineering experience within crypto or Web3, including responsibility for production pipelines or a data platform.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building maintainable data processing workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Airflow, Kafka, and Spark.
  • Experience with data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data modelling.
  • The ability to investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot pipeline failures, and resolve underlying causes.
  • The ability to work independently and communicate technical details and business requirements clearly in Mandarin.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a centralised crypto exchange, particularly with trading, order, or account data.
  • BI experience, including supporting dashboards, defining metrics, or preparing datasets for business users.
  • Strong English communication skills.

Working with us

This role is fully remote within APAC, with Mandarin as the team’s main working language. You’ll work on a data platform connected to the daily operations of a crypto exchange and help colleagues get dependable answers from its data.

If you enjoy building data systems and understanding how people use them, we’d like to hear from you.

About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

DriveWealth is seeking a hands-on Senior QA Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team supporting post-trade platforms: clearing, custody, settlement, and the back-office systems that follow trade execution. This role is embedded within a product engineering team and focuses on scalable automation, high-quality releases, and stronger testing practices across the SDLC.
The ideal candidate has strong technical automation experience and prior exposure to post-trade processing, reconciliation, and margin products in a broker-dealer or clearing environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks using Java, Cucumber (BDD), and RestAssured
  • Build and execute automated tests across API, event/messaging (Kafka, queue-based integrations), and data layers, with UI coverage where applicable
  • Validate end-to-end post-trade workflows, including trade settlement, positions and cash, corporate actions, options lifecycle (exercise, assignment, expiration), margin, asset transfers (ACATS), and cost basis/tax lots
  • Design and automate reconciliation tests between DriveWealth systems and clearing/custodian platforms, validating positions, balances, and transactions
    Validate downstream outputs such as trade confirmations, statements, and regulatory reports (e.g., CAT/FINRA)
  • Create test plans, scenarios, and regression suites for financial systems, including migration and parallel-run validation
  • Build and maintain CI/CD test pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
  • Performance Testing experience
  • Analyze test results, troubleshoot defects, and improve test coverage
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Compliance teams on testing strategy and quality improvements
  • Participate in test reviews, bug triage, and production issue analysis

You Bring

  • 8+ years of QA experience in financial services, with direct exposure to post-trade, clearing, or back-office platforms
  • Strong hands-on programming in Java
  • Automation experience with Cucumber/BDD and RestAssured
  • Experience testing REST APIs and event-driven systems (Kafka; RabbitMQ or SQS a plus)
  • Strong SQL (Postgres) skills for data validation and reconciliation
  • Working knowledge of post-trade concepts: settlement cycles, corporate actions, margin, options lifecycle, and books-and-records requirements
  • Experience with AWS, Git, and Jenkins
  • Familiarity with JIRA and test management tools (Allure TestOps)

Special Knowledge (Nice to Have, But Not Required)

  • Playwright and TypeScript for UI automation
  • Experience with a clearing system conversion or platform migration
  • Exposure to FIX protocol, crypto asset workflows, or data tools such as Databricks

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: Hyderabad, IN

  • This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
  • If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.  If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

About Mantle

We’re building an AI agent to help families support their aging parents (origin story here).

 

Over 40M “sandwich generation” Americans currently manage their parent’s affairs. Keeping mom/dad safe and supported is like a second job: it’s time-consuming, stressful and on top of their already busy lives. We believe that managing our parents’ affairs should feel under control, easier and lower stress.

 

Co-founded by serial entrepreneur partners including Ted Zagat, who sold his previous businesses to Slack (announcement here) and Google (Zagat restaurant guides).

The Role

We are looking for a Social & Content Marketing Manager to build Mantle's voice in the world. The sandwich generation is juggling a lot, and the content they see about caring for aging parents is too often clinical, overwhelming or dull. You'll create content that feels like a helpful friend: honest, useful and human. You will work side-by-side with our founders and marketing team to grow an audience that trusts Mantle.

This is a role for a builder and a maker. In the early days, you'll be the one writing the posts, filming the videos, working with creators and responding to comments yourself. It's not just about strategy; it's about consistently shipping great content, learning what resonates, and doing more of it.

What You'll Build

  • Social presence: Grow Mantle's organic audience across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube and wherever our families spend time.

  • Content engine: Create and publish a steady stream of short-form video, posts, articles and newsletters.

  • Creator partnerships: Find and partner with creators and voices our audience already trusts.

  • Brand voice: Help define how Mantle sounds and shows up to the world.

  • Community: Engage directly with the people who follow and share our content.

  • Content analytics: Track what's resonating and turn those learnings into better content.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 3+ years of social media and content marketing experience, ideally at a consumer startup or high-growth company

  • Track record of growing an organic audience and engagement on at least two major platforms

  • Strong writing skills and comfort creating short-form video yourself

  • Experience working with creators or influencers

  • AI adept: savvy with AI tools (LLMs, agents) to increase your own personal leverage

Ideal Background

  • Early-stage startup experience where you were the first social or content hire

  • Experience marketing to busy adults, especially parents or caregivers

  • Experience making complex or sensitive topics feel simple and approachable

  • A portfolio of content you're proud of

  • Nice to have, but not required: experience with FinTech

Who Thrives Here

  • Builders: You love creating things from scratch and taking full ownership

  • Makers: You'd rather ship ten posts and learn than plan one perfect one

  • Empathetic: You understand what our audience is going through and write for them

  • Scrappy: You operate well without a lot of structure or resources and find ways to "get it done"

  • AI-forward: You embrace modern AI

  • Autonomous: You thrive with minimal direction

  • Mission-driven: You care about what we're building

What You'll Get

  • Meaningful work: Build a brand that will make a real difference in the lives of millions of families, with fast pace and huge financial potential

  • Small team impact: Work directly with founders and see immediate impact from your work

  • Partnership with founders: Work closely with Mantle's co-founders and other company leaders

  • Learning & growth: Opportunity to build a category-defining company from the ground up

  • Real ownership: Your decisions will shape our brand, business and culture

  • Remote Fridays: Work from home every Friday. Monday through Thursday, we build together in person in San Francisco
